page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; running head at top with page number at top right. No marginal notes or footnotes.

main_text.l: cæ, fœtum in vitæ & mortis confinio
tris, in spem ut vitalis foret, assurge-
edixisti, hactenus à me parata arma,
& nomine tenus decretoria esse in Po-
cartæ, nec ullo Scripto contrario à
tuo judicio usque adeo cogentia, qui-
cationem asserit & astruit, ut ad pall-
mis cogerent retractare verba quæ non

page.notes: Catchword-like word "esset" at right foot is part of the text line and was kept in the text. Some letters are faint or blurred near "quaternionem" and "pallnodiam"; the reading is as printed.
